v09-c10.scope: 7,501 words; four full alternative-asset cases, eight solved exercises, exact offline lab and six scoped sources read.
reasoning: Property NOI/capital expenditure and forward exit date are distinct; debt interest uses opening principal. Every asset cash equals debt plus equity; par loan quote and asset discounting are not interchanged.
Conventional IRR and general negative-prefix/positive-suffix unique-root claims have explicit domain and elementary monotonicity proofs; no ranking theorem or debt-created value is asserted.

Stationary geometric smoothing uses jointly IID latent/market returns; finite fixed-initial-value path and compound wealth are separated from population covariance and additive horizon variance. Unsmoothing is conditional, not evidence of true risk.

Investment commitment excludes management fees by contract. Carry has a specified terminal base; LP paid-in capital and net distributions reconcile. The synthetic future-valued comparison is not risk-adjusted alpha or a guaranteed cash-funded replica.

Calls and fees precede distributions. Delayed negative balances are unfunded diagnostics; reserve repair reduces the initial gated allocation and preserves total initial wealth. No future NAV is treated as immediately withdrawable cash.

Futures variation is separate from zero-price replacement contract entry and commodity spot change. Interest, management and high-water fees settle before the specified margin test. Positive NAV need not satisfy margin; stopped paths have no implemented final return.
